AttributeList.Text: NOT YET WIRED INTO Main[OB1]. Generated 2026-08-08 from the real addresses confirmed live in TIA's Device overview after assigning all 3 ET200SP stations (AFT/MID/FWD) to PLC_1's PROFINET IO system - before that, every module showed no address at all. This is the only block in the whole project that references real physical %I/%Q addresses; everything downstream (FC_IoMapper, Valve_Channels_DB) only ever deals with the abstract 1..368 / 1..208 channel numbers in IO_Buffer_DB. Still needs: (1) FB_ValveLoop simulation guard for real-mapped valves, (2) both this and FC_IoMapper actually called from Main[OB1] - see FC_IoMapper's own header comment. Safe to have present unwired: it only touches IO_Buffer_DB, which nothing else reads yet.
